comment: UNVERIFIED except for the sign-in prompt: written against Kiro CLI 2.28.0 without a Kiro account, so no live chat session could be recorded. Only 'Press enter to continue to the browser or esc to cancel' (the sign-in prompt of an unauthenticated 'kiro-cli chat') was seen on screen (BLOCKED). Kiro 2.x has two UIs, the legacy line UI (--legacy-ui, the former Amazon Q Developer CLI) and a new terminal UI (--tui); which one starts by default could not be checked. The legacy patterns come from the string table of kiro-cli-chat: the tool question 'Allow this action? Use 't' to trust (always allow) the '<tool>' tool for the session. [y/n/t]:' (BLOCKED, last lines only because the legacy UI writes into the scrollback), the 'Thinking...' spinner (WORKING) and the '>' / '!>' (trust-all) prompt (IDLE). The new TUI is described only in Kiro's documentation: a '⏸' status icon on a tool that awaits approval and a notification bar with Yes, Trust and No (BLOCKED). The fallback is IDLE, so an unrecognised TUI screen does not read as working forever. The fixtures other than the sign-in prompt are synthesized and named synthetic-*. Must be re-verified against live authenticated sessions in both UIs.

anyLineRegex: ^\s*Press enter to continue to the browser or esc to cancel\s*$
requires approval, press 'y' to approve and 'n' to deny
